DPP Explorer third-party assets

Map geometry: Made with Natural Earth.
Natural Earth 1:110m Admin 0 Countries, repository release v5.1.2.
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/
Public domain; full notice and source credits are in NATURAL-EARTH-LICENSE.md.

Natural Earth depicts de facto boundaries. The map is a generalised visual aid,
not an authoritative determination of legal jurisdiction or territorial status.
Some small jurisdictions are absent from the 1:110m geometry. Use the dataset
selector and table for complete research coverage.

Visualisation library: D3 7.9.0 by Mike Bostock and contributors.
https://d3js.org/
ISC license; full notice is in D3-LICENSE.txt.

Both files are unmodified, version-pinned local copies. Source URLs, retrieval
date, checksums and limitations are recorded in provenance.json.
